method: C1 mutually-exclusive-sum-over (sum of YES mids - 1 > 0.06, fully two-sided events; high) / C1b -under (1 - sum > 0.06, >= 3 markets; info — the exchange flag does not imply an exhaustive outcome set); C2 crossed-book (bid > ask; high); C3 stale-last-vs-book (last trade > 0.1 outside the book; info). Findings are published, never used to alter data.
